home.title: Welcome to the Israeli Digital Humanities Index
home.subtitle: Discover the people, projects, organizations, and resources shaping digital humanities in Israel.

seo.description: Explore people, organizations, projects, datasets, tools, publications, and other resources in Israel's digital humanities community.
seo.about_description: Learn about the Israeli Digital Humanities Index and its catalogue of people, organizations, projects, and resources.
seo.entity_description: Explore {{name}} in the Israeli Digital Humanities Index.

about.title: About
about.intro: The Israeli Digital Humanities Index (IDHI) is a shared gateway to digital humanities research, resources, and expertise across Israel.

why.title: Bringing a distributed community together
why.body: Digital humanities projects, publications, datasets, tools, and expertise in Israel are spread across many institutions. This makes valuable work harder to discover, reuse, and build upon. IDHI brings these resources together in one publicly accessible place, strengthening connections within the community and opening its work to researchers and the wider public.

directory.title: A national directory for digital humanities
directory.body: The index documents projects, publications, datasets, digital tools, repositories, research centres, events, educational programmes, people, organisations, and other digital humanities resources. A single searchable platform makes this activity easier to explore and provides a unified entry point to computational tools and digital collections.

discover.title: Improve discovery
discover.body: Make digital humanities work and expertise in Israel visible and accessible through one national index.

connect.title: Support collaboration
connect.body: Help people and institutions find one another, share knowledge, and avoid duplicating existing efforts.

preserve.title: Sustain research outputs
preserve.body: Create durable records of projects and resources so they remain discoverable and can support future work.

represent.title: Strengthen international visibility
represent.body: Present Israeli digital humanities as a connected community and link its work with international research infrastructures.

dariah.title: Part of DARIAH-IL
dariah.body: IDHI is being developed as part of DARIAH-IL (Digital Research Infrastructure for the Arts and Humanities in Israel). The initiative connects local digital humanities activity with international infrastructures, helping the Israeli community participate in a wider network of research, tools, and knowledge.

technical.title: Explore and contribute
technical.intro: IDHI is built on open standards and open-source software. Explore the technical foundations of the index, and help improve it by sharing feedback or contributing code.

ontology.title: Ontology and schema
ontology.body: Read the ontology and full schema documentation that describes the index's data model.

api.title: OpenAPI specification
api.body: Explore the API specification for integrating with and building on the index.

code.title: Source code
code.body: Review the index's code and submit a pull request to help improve it.

ai.title: Connect to AI
ai.intro: The Israeli Digital Humanities Index provides a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. Connecting it to your AI assistant lets it search the index, look up entries, and - after signing in - create, update, or delete entries, all from within your chat or coding tool.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.public: Available to everyone, no sign-in required:

tools.search_entities: search the index with free-text queries, filters, facets, sorting, and pagination
tools.get_entity: fetch a single entry by its ID

capabilities.auth_note: Authentication uses the standard MCP OAuth flow: the first time your tool calls a write tool, it opens the index sign-in page in your browser and continues automatically once you approve.
